description: This Java class `ImmutablePlaceholderResolver` is an immutable implementation of the `PlaceholderResolver` interface, providing methods for resolving placeholders and managing placeholder sources within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutablePlaceholderResolver
classes.description: An immutable class that implements `PlaceholderResolver` to resolve placeholders with a fixed `Placeholder` and an optional source value.

methods.name: ImmutablePlaceholderResolver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the placeholder and optional placeholder source.

methods.name: getPlaceholderSource
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the placeholder source if available.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a placeholder given a source and a name, delegating to the encapsulated Placeholder.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string used in placeholders, delegated to the Placeholder object.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported placeholder names, delegated to the Placeholder object.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a given placeholder name is supported.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on the placeholder and placeholderSource fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on placeholder and placeholderSource.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the resolver, including its placeholder and value.
